text:
All sidewalks in the public streets or thoroughfares to be constructed, reconstructed or repaired shall be subject to the supervision and approval of the City Engineer. (Ord. 17439 § 7, 12-7-99. Code 1981 § 40-167. Code 1995 § 130-375.)
Cross References: City Engineer, TMC 2.20.100 .
title: Work to be supervised by City Engineer.
